messages.subject: URGENT: Confirm your placement test seat within 1 hour
messages.body:
Dear Student,

You have been shortlisted for a guaranteed placement offer with our partner company. Seats are limited!
To confirm your seat, transfer a refundable deposit of Rs 1500 via UPI to placementdesk@quickpay.example within 1 hour, or your slot will be given away.
This is a golden opportunity, act fast.

Placement Cell Assist Team
